sections.title: THE GAME
sections.content: **Necromunda Underhive Wars** is a turn-based tactical RPG set in the dystopian universe of Warhammer 40,000. Lead and customize rival gangs through brutal tactical battles, using strategic positioning, environmental hazards, and unique abilities to dominate the Underhive.
